title: Additivity of the measure over a finite set
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite probability space, and let $T$ be a finite subset of $\Omega$. Writing $\mathbb{P}$ for the real-valued probability measure on $\Omega$, the measure of $T$ is the sum of the measures of its singletons:
\[
  \mathbb{P}(T) \;=\; \sum_{a \in T} \mathbb{P}(\{a\}).
\]
